Good catch. Fixed in 8755f15 — the static model ID now matches the canonical registry entry (Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct without the -2507 suffix).

The live /v1/models endpoint does return the -2507 suffix, but when dynamic discovery runs, the canonical filter maps it back to the registry ID. The static fallback now uses the same ID the canonical registry expects.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Good catch — fixed in 1f2529b0. I dropped the reasoning flag from anthropic/claude-opus-4.7.

You're right that on the declarative OpenAI-engine path create_request only emits reasoning_effort for is_openai_responses_model matches, so a thinking effort set against the Anthropic model would be silently dropped (Claude needs a native top-level thinking block, which this generic path doesn't send). Rather than add OrcaRouter-specific request handling — which would mean a full custom provider and is more than this declarative addition warrants — I removed the misleading capability flag. The model stays available for normal chat/tool use; OpenAI-family models still get reasoning_effort via the existing name-based detection.
